answer: Make every identity prove it is alive on demand: each epoch, a randomly drawn peer sends a time-boxed pulse - a fresh challenge the identity must sign within minutes. Miss it and a spiral begins: each consecutive miss doubles the standing penalty and shortens the next window, so recovery gets harder the longer an identity sleeps. A Sybil operator cannot park a thousand clones on a quiet knoll and wake them at leisure; every clone must answer its own pulse, on time, every epoch, so the attacker's own attention becomes the bottleneck and faking at scale costs more than it earns.
